Name: Taberah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the wilderness, near Kibroth-hattaavah
Description: Taberah, 'burning', was the wilderness camp where the fire of the LORD burned among the people because of their complaining, until Moses prayed and the fire was quenched.
BiblicalSignificance: Taberah is the camp of the first wilderness fire: complaint answered by burning, and burning stopped by Moses' prayer.
